states.name: PROCESS_BATCH
states.description: Stateless per-scan batch processing state. On every invocation, sample inputs once, process ordinals j in [0, count), and write only channels[].retVal and channels[].outputValue for enabled channels according to mode/limit validation.

actions: stage 1: sample count, array lower bounds, analogValues, channel configuration fields, and pre-scan retVal/outputValue
stage 2: enforce read-only safety, classify each ordinal as skip/preserve, invalid mode, invalid limits, or convert mode 0/1/2
stage 3: call no timers because no timer FBs are required
stage 4: perform unified output assignment only for processed enabled channels

timer_plan.reset_conditions: None. No timer FBs, PT durations, or reset conditions are required for this stateless batch-conversion function block.
timer_plan.notes: Stage 3 is explicitly empty. If timers were added later, their FB calls would be unconditional top-level calls outside CASE/IF.

priorities: Never modify analogValues or any channel configuration field: enable, hiLIM, loLIM, bipolar, measuringMode.
Process only ordinals j from 0 through count-1, pairing analogValues and channels at each array's own lower bound plus j.
Preserve retVal and outputValue for disabled channels and for ordinals greater than or equal to count.
For enabled channels, validate measuringMode before limit validation. If measuringMode is not 0, 1, or 2, set retVal=16#8001 and preserve outputValue.
For enabled channels with valid measuringMode, validate limits in every mode. If hiLIM <= loLIM, set retVal=16#8002 and preserve outputValue.
For enabled channels with valid measuringMode and valid limits, perform conversion, set retVal=0, and write outputValue.
Sample all inputs and preserve pre-scan output values before making any output writes.
Perform output assignments only in the final unified output stage; do not write outputs inside per-channel conversion calculations.

initial_values.count: caller-provided DINT; read-only to the FB
initial_values.analogValues: caller-provided ARRAY[*] OF INT; read-only and never modified by the FB
initial_values.channels: caller-provided ARRAY[*] OF ST_AnalogChannel; only retVal and outputValue may be written for enabled processed channels
initial_values.loopIndex_j: 0 at the start of each scan; incremented while j < count
initial_values.preserved_outputValue: pre-scan channels[].outputValue sampled before any writes

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.details: At the top of each scan, sample count, array lower bounds, analogValues elements, channel configuration fields, and pre-scan retVal/outputValue values. No edge-triggered history is required; sample once for later stages.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.details: Enter/remain in PROCESS_BATCH. Enforce read-only rules. For each j in [0, count), evaluate enabled = channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable. Validate measuringMode first; if invalid, classify as ERROR_MODE. Otherwise validate hiLIM > loLIM; if invalid, classify as ERROR_LIMITS. Otherwise classify as CONVERT_MODE0, CONVERT_MODE1, or CONVERT_MODE2. Reset per-scan decision flags.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.details: No timer FBs are used. This stage is intentionally empty. Any future timer calls must be placed here as unconditional top-level calls outside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.details: After all per-channel decisions, write outputs. For j < count and enabled: if ERROR_MODE, set retVal=16#8001 and preserve outputValue; if ERROR_LIMITS, set retVal=16#8002 and preserve outputValue; if valid, set retVal=0 and write the computed outputValue. For disabled or out-of-count channels, do not write retVal or outputValue. Never write analogValues or channel configuration fields.

formal_assertions.formula: G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j] = PRE(analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j]) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].bipolar = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].bipolar) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): (NOT(j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable)) -> (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].retVal = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].retVal) AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue)))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND NOT(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode IN {0,1,2})) -> (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].retVal = 16#8001 AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue))))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode IN {0,1,2} AND NOT(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM > channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM)) -> (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].retVal = 16#8002 AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = PRE(channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue))))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode IN {0,1,2} AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM > channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) -> channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].retVal = 0))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode = 0 AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM > channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) -> channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].bipolar ? channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM + ((analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j] + 27648) / 55296) * (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM - channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) : channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM + (analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j] / 27648) * (channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM - channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM))))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode = 1 AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM > channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) -> channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j] / 10.0))

G(forall j in [0,len(channels)): ((j < count AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].enable AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].measuringMode = 2 AND channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].hiLIM > channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].loLIM) -> channels[LOWER_BOUND(channels)+j].outputValue = analogValues[LOWER_BOUND(analogValues)+j] / 100.0))
